RustO! (@rustors/web 0.4.1) WebAssembly runtime: MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/byrizki/rusto-rs
Models: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 mobile detection + korean_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec (Apache-2.0, PaddlePaddle), RTen format from @rustors/model-ppocrv5-mobile and @rustors/model-ppocrv5-korean 0.3.2 (MIT packaging).
